daily_production.description: Daily measurements per wellbore, from Equinor's daily production report: hours on stream, pressures, temperatures, choke opening and the volumes produced or injected. One row per `(date, npd_wellbore_code)`. Volumes are in standard cubic metres (Sm³).

columns.name: date
columns.description: Production day (source `DATEPRD`). Stored in the Parquet file as a timestamp at midnight.

columns.name: npd_wellbore_code
columns.description: Wellbore the row belongs to. Joins to `wells`.

columns.name: on_stream_hours
columns.description: Hours the wellbore was producing or injecting that day (`ON_STREAM_HRS`). Up to 25 on the day the clocks go back.

columns.name: avg_downhole_pressure
columns.description: Average pressure at the downhole gauge over the day, in bar (`AVG_DOWNHOLE_PRESSURE`).

columns.name: avg_dp_tubing
columns.description: Average pressure drop along the production tubing, from the downhole gauge to the wellhead, in bar (`AVG_DP_TUBING`).

columns.name: avg_annulus_pressure
columns.description: Average pressure in the annulus between tubing and casing, in bar (`AVG_ANNULUS_PRESS`).

columns.name: avg_wellhead_pressure
columns.description: Average pressure at the wellhead, in bar (`AVG_WHP_P`).

columns.name: avg_downhole_temperature
columns.description: Average temperature at the downhole gauge, in °C (`AVG_DOWNHOLE_TEMPERATURE`).

columns.name: avg_wellhead_temperature
columns.description: Average temperature at the wellhead, in °C (`AVG_WHT_P`).

columns.name: avg_choke_size_percent
columns.description: Average production choke opening, as a percentage of fully open (`AVG_CHOKE_SIZE_P`).

columns.name: avg_choke_unit
columns.description: Unit of `avg_choke_size_percent`: `%`, or NULL on injection rows (`AVG_CHOKE_UOM`).

columns.name: dp_choke_size
columns.description: Pressure drop across the production choke, in bar (`DP_CHOKE_SIZE`).

columns.name: oil_volume
columns.description: Oil produced from the wellbore that day, in Sm³ (`BORE_OIL_VOL`).

columns.name: gas_volume
columns.description: Gas produced from the wellbore that day, in Sm³ (`BORE_GAS_VOL`).

columns.name: water_volume
columns.description: Water produced from the wellbore that day, in Sm³ (`BORE_WAT_VOL`). A few rows are negative, kept as the source reports them.

columns.name: water_injection_volume
columns.description: Water injected into the wellbore that day, in Sm³ (`BORE_WI_VOL`). Filled on injection rows and on a handful of production rows.

columns.name: flow_kind
columns.description: Direction of flow that day: `production` or `injection` (`FLOW_KIND`).

columns.name: well_type
columns.description: Role of the wellbore that day: `OP` oil producer, `WI` water injector (`WELL_TYPE`). Can change over a wellbore's life.

wells.description: One row per wellbore the public wellbore register of the Norwegian Offshore Directorate assigns to the Volve field, drilled or not: its identifiers, the register's classification and the wellbore it was drilled from. The production columns come from Equinor's production report and are empty for a wellbore without production; `has_production` marks the wellbores that have production rows.

columns.name: npd_wellbore_code
columns.description: Wellbore identifier assigned by the Norwegian Offshore Directorate (formerly the Norwegian Petroleum Directorate, NPD). The key every production row joins on.

columns.name: wellbore_code
columns.description: Equinor's wellbore code, prefixed with the country (e.g. `NO 15/9-F-12 H`), from the production report. Empty for a wellbore without production.

columns.name: wellbore_name
columns.description: NPD wellbore name (e.g. `15/9-F-12`, a well in block 15/9). Use this to label wells.

columns.name: npd_field_code
columns.description: NPD field identifier. The same value on every row: Volve.

columns.name: npd_field_name
columns.description: Field name: `VOLVE` on every row.

columns.name: npd_facility_code
columns.description: NPD identifier of the facility the wellbore produced through. Empty for a wellbore without production.

columns.name: npd_facility_name
columns.description: Facility the wellbore produced through: the `MÆRSK INSPIRER` jack-up production unit. Empty for a wellbore without production.

columns.name: wellbore_type
columns.description: Register well type: `DEVELOPMENT` for the wellbores drilled to develop the field, `EXPLORATION` for those drilled to find and appraise it (source `wlbWellType`).

columns.name: purpose
columns.description: What the register says the wellbore was drilled for: `PRODUCTION`, `INJECTION` or `OBSERVATION` for a development wellbore, `WILDCAT` or `APPRAISAL` for an exploration one (source `wlbPurpose`).

columns.name: content
columns.description: What the register says the wellbore found or carries, such as `OIL`, `WATER`, `SHOWS`, `DRY` or `NOT APPLICABLE` (source `wlbContent`). Empty for a wellbore that was never drilled.

columns.name: completion_year
columns.description: Year the wellbore was completed, from the register (source `wlbCompletionYear`). Empty for a wellbore that was never drilled.

columns.name: parent_npd_wellbore_code
columns.description: `npd_wellbore_code` of the wellbore this one was sidetracked or re-entered from, itself a row of this table (source `wlbDiskosWellboreParent`). Empty for a wellbore drilled from the surface.

columns.name: has_production
columns.description: True when the wellbore has rows in the production tables, `daily_production` and `monthly_production`; false otherwise.

monthly_production.description: Monthly volumes per wellbore, from Equinor's monthly production report. One row per `(date, npd_wellbore_code)`, where `date` is the first day of the month. Volumes are in standard cubic metres (Sm³).

columns.name: date
columns.description: First day of the month the volumes cover, built from the source `Year` and `Month`. Stored in the Parquet file as a timestamp.

columns.name: npd_wellbore_code
columns.description: Wellbore the row belongs to. Joins to `wells`.

columns.name: on_stream_hours
columns.description: Hours the wellbore was on stream in the month (`On Stream`).

columns.name: oil_volume_sm3
columns.description: Oil produced in the month, in Sm³ (`Oil`).

columns.name: gas_volume_sm3
columns.description: Gas produced in the month, in Sm³ (`Gas`).

columns.name: water_volume_sm3
columns.description: Water produced in the month, in Sm³ (`Water`).

columns.name: gas_injection_sm3
columns.description: Gas injected in the month, in Sm³ (`GI`). Empty in every row of the source.

columns.name: water_injection_sm3
columns.description: Water injected in the month, in Sm³ (`WI`).

petrophysical_interpretation.description: Well-log Curves of Equinor's petrophysical interpretation, one row per depth sample of each logged wellbore: the Input curves the interpretation took (gamma ray, density, neutron, sonic, resistivity) and the Interpreted curves it computed (porosity, water saturation, shale volume, permeability, lithology flags) side by side. One row per `(source_wellbore, depth_md)`. Each Curve column is named with the source mnemonic and is empty where the wellbore has no sample. Each Curve has one documented unit, stated with the column: the source files spell it several ways, and the values are kept as the source gives them, never converted. Samples are at the source depths; nothing is resampled. A source depth is kept only where a Curve other than the lithology and bad-data flags has a value: some files pad the wellbore with samples whose only value is a flag, and those are dropped. The file is a single row group, sorted by `npd_wellbore_code`, `source_wellbore` and `depth_md`; the key columns come first, then the Curves in descending order of how many wellbores carry them, ties by mnemonic, so the most common Curves come first. Built from the raw log files; the Parquet is not in git.

columns.name: npd_wellbore_code
columns.description: Wellbore the row belongs to. Joins to `wells`. For a Technical sidetrack, the code of its parent Wellbore.

columns.name: source_wellbore
columns.description: The operator's name for the logged wellbore, such as `15/9-F-1 A`, taken from the folder the source files sit in. Usually the name of the Wellbore in `npd_wellbore_code`. A Technical sidetrack, such as `15/9-F-11 T2`, is a re-drilled section the register does not count as a Wellbore: its rows carry the `npd_wellbore_code` of its parent Wellbore (`15/9-F-11`) and keep the Technical sidetrack's name here. The 15/9-F-11 top-hole section is `15/9-F-11`: it has Input curves only, and it overlaps the depths of `15/9-F-11 T2` with different values. Filter on `npd_wellbore_code` for everything logged under a Wellbore, on `source_wellbore` for one of its sources.

columns.name: depth_md
columns.description: Measured depth along the wellbore, in metres, rounded to four decimals so that equality joins are stable. Source files that index depth in tenths of an inch or in millimetres are converted to metres before rounding. The depth reference is the one the source file uses; it is not normalised.

columns.name: BVW
columns.description: Bulk volume of water: porosity times water saturation, as a fraction of rock volume.

columns.name: COAL_FLAG
columns.description: Lithology flag: 1 where the interpretation marks coal, 0 elsewhere.

columns.name: GR
columns.description: Natural gamma ray.

columns.name: KLOGH
columns.description: Horizontal permeability computed from the logs.

columns.name: NPHI
columns.description: Neutron porosity, as a fraction.

columns.name: RHOB
columns.description: Bulk density.

columns.name: RT
columns.description: True formation resistivity, as the interpreter selected it.

columns.name: SAND_FLAG
columns.description: Lithology flag: 1 where the interpretation marks sand, 0 elsewhere.

columns.name: VSH
columns.description: Shale volume, as a fraction.

columns.name: PHIF
columns.description: Final effective porosity from the interpretation, as a fraction.

columns.name: RD
columns.description: Deep resistivity.

columns.name: SW
columns.description: Water saturation from the interpretation, as a fraction of pore volume.

columns.name: DRHO
columns.description: Density correction applied to the bulk density.

columns.name: CALI
columns.description: Caliper: measured borehole diameter.

columns.name: CARB_FLAG
columns.description: Lithology flag: 1 where the interpretation marks carbonate, 0 elsewhere.

columns.name: DT
columns.description: Compressional sonic slowness.

columns.name: PEF
columns.description: Photoelectric factor.

columns.name: RS
columns.description: Shallow resistivity.

columns.name: ABDCQF01
columns.description: Bulk density from quadrant 1 of an azimuthal density measurement while drilling.

columns.name: ABDCQF02
columns.description: Bulk density from quadrant 2 of an azimuthal density measurement while drilling.

columns.name: ABDCQF03
columns.description: Bulk density from quadrant 3 of an azimuthal density measurement while drilling.

columns.name: ABDCQF04
columns.description: Bulk density from quadrant 4 of an azimuthal density measurement while drilling.

columns.name: BS
columns.description: Bit size: nominal diameter of the drilled hole.

columns.name: RACEHM
columns.description: Propagation resistivity while drilling, from the attenuation of the high-frequency signal.

columns.name: RACELM
columns.description: Propagation resistivity while drilling, from the attenuation of the low-frequency signal.

columns.name: ROP
columns.description: Rate of penetration while drilling.

columns.name: RPCEHM
columns.description: Propagation resistivity while drilling, from the phase shift of the high-frequency signal.

columns.name: RPCELM
columns.description: Propagation resistivity while drilling, from the phase shift of the low-frequency signal.

columns.name: RM
columns.description: Medium resistivity.

columns.name: DTS
columns.description: Shear sonic slowness.

columns.name: VCARB
columns.description: Volume of carbonate minerals (calcite, dolomite, siderite), as a fraction.

columns.name: DRHU
columns.description: Density correction applied to `ROBU`, the bulk density from the top of the borehole, measured while drilling.

columns.name: NBGRCFM
columns.description: Natural gamma ray measured near the bit while drilling.

columns.name: ROBU
columns.description: Bulk density from the top of the borehole, measured while drilling by a rotating density tool.

columns.name: ROBB
columns.description: Bulk density from the bottom of the borehole, measured while drilling by a rotating density tool.

columns.name: BADDATA_FLAG
columns.description: Interpreted flag: 1 where the interpreter judged the log data unreliable, 0 elsewhere.

columns.name: DRHB
columns.description: Density correction applied to `ROBB`, the bulk density from the bottom of the borehole, measured while drilling.

columns.name: PHID
columns.description: Porosity computed from the bulk density, as a fraction.

columns.name: ROP5_RM
columns.description: Rate of penetration while drilling, a second recording. Its file leaves the unit unknown; its values lie in the range `ROP` has in the other wellbores, so it is documented in the same unit.

log_curves.description: The Curve catalog: one row per log table, Wellbore or Technical sidetrack, and Curve that has data there. Read it first to learn which Curves each one has, over which depths, and which raw file each came from, before reading any samples. One row per `(table_name, source_wellbore, mnemonic)`; a Curve that is empty for a `source_wellbore` has no row. Its depth range and sample count are those of the table it describes. Built with the log tables from the raw log files; the Parquet is not in git.

columns.name: table_name
columns.description: The log table the Curve is a column of, such as `petrophysical_interpretation`.

columns.name: npd_wellbore_code
columns.description: Wellbore the Curve was logged in. Joins to `wells`. For a Technical sidetrack, the code of its parent Wellbore.

columns.name: source_wellbore
columns.description: The operator's name for the logged Wellbore or Technical sidetrack, as in the log table's `source_wellbore`: a Wellbore, a Technical sidetrack such as `15/9-F-11 T2`, or the 15/9-F-11 top-hole section.

columns.name: mnemonic
columns.description: The Curve's source mnemonic: the name of its column in the log table.

columns.name: curve_kind
columns.description: `input` for an Input curve, a measurement the petrophysical interpretation took as input; `interpreted` for an Interpreted curve it computed. A Curve in both the input and the output file is an Input curve.

columns.name: unit
columns.description: The one unit documented for the Curve's column, as the schema documents write it.

columns.name: source_unit
columns.description: The unit as the source file spells it, such as `V/V` or `UNKNOWN`. The values are not converted: every spelling the build accepts means the documented unit.

columns.name: first_depth_md
columns.description: Shallowest measured depth at which the Curve has a sample.

columns.name: last_depth_md
columns.description: Deepest measured depth at which the Curve has a sample.

columns.name: sample_count
columns.description: Number of depth samples at which the Curve has a value.

columns.name: source_file
columns.description: Path of the file the Curve was read from, within the Raw repo `oskrgab/petrodb-raw-volve`. A Curve in both files of a pair names the input file.
